name: 2017 livery
description: White all over. The TAP logo very large on the forward fuselage just behind the cockpit (a green T with a small white A arrow, a red P), 'AIR PORTUGAL' in dark gray ahead of the wing, 'flytap.com' small at the rear. The fin is the logo cropped: lime green along the leading edge, red aft of a slanting line with two white bars (the P's counter), 'AIR PORTUGAL' set vertically in white. Unmirrored on the right: lime along the trailing edge, red forward with a white bar and white at the leading edge's foot, the title reading upward. Sharklets red below, green above.

logos.description: The TAP logo (2005), very large just behind the cockpit door: a blocky green T (lime top, deeper green stem) with a small white upward arrow standing for the A, then a red P whose counter is a white square; reads left to right on both sides.
Small Star Alliance star outline next to the forward door.
Small Portuguese flag after the registration, under the rear windows.

titles.style: 'AIR' in bold capitals, ahead of 'PORTUGAL' (left side: placed as the right side's stretch, mirrored; no side-on left photo measured).
'AIR' in bold capitals; on the right side it's aft, reading first from that side.
'PORTUGAL' in regular capitals, forward of 'AIR' on the right side.
Small lower-case web address over the rear windows.
Set vertically, reading upward, on the red just aft of the green: 'AIR' bold, 'PORTUGAL' regular; runs from the root to about 0.75 of the span.

Right face: set vertically, reading upward (the left face's picture isn't mirrored here), on the red just ahead of the trailing edge's lime: 'AIR' bold, 'PORTUGAL' regular; from just above the root to about 0.76 of the span. Placed as the left face's picture (x is 1 - the right face's), at its top end.

notes: The fin title is vertical (90° anticlockwise); a renderer that lays titles horizontally will misplace it. The right face shows the fin art unmirrored: the same picture as the left, so it still reads T then P from left to right (green at the trailing edge on the right, red forward). Checked 2026-11-22 for the order: the logo and the fin read T (green) then P (red) from either side, as here; nothing in this scheme assumes P before T. The right face has its own areas and title (side: right, 2026-11-22), as TAP/express's: the left's picture reversed put a big lime field forward and the title reading down off the trailing edge, where CS-TJM's and CS-TXA's right sides (2022-09-19) show red with lime only along the trailing edge, widening toward the tip, white at the leading edge's foot to about a third of the span and a white bar at about 0.58-0.74, and 'AIR PORTUGAL' reading upward just ahead of the lime. Measured from front-quarter photos by mapping the fin's corners onto shapes/A21N.json (within about 0.05 of the span). Some older A319/A320/A330ceo still carried the 2005 'TAP Portugal' scheme (logo on the fin, smaller fuselage titles) after 2017; not drawn here. Belly not seen in detail: white. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on CS-TJM (A321neo, right side, side-on): 'AIR' (bold) and 'PORTUGAL' (regular) are different lettering reading as one line, so a pair per side; the line runs x 0.364-0.525 (it had started at 0.33, over the logo's aft end); 'flytap.com' x 0.748-0.813; the fin title runs about 0.78 of the root chord. The left side's pair is placed as the right side shows it, mirrored (low).
history: Replaced Skyarium v1's approximation (green belly, red stripe). The 2017 rebrand moved the 2005 logo large onto the fuselage and retitled the airline 'TAP Air Portugal'.
